name: task-forge
description: Task Forge — organizations, workspaces, teams, projects, kanban boards, real-time collaboration.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/database
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:realtime: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/realtime
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/realtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker
